high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "Major," which is scheduled to be released on February 11th, 2022. The poster features a silhouette of a person standing in the center, wearing what appears to be military attire, suggesting a theme related to the military or action. Title and Credits: The title "MAJOR" is prominently displayed at the top in large, bold letters. Below the title, it states that the film is directed by Sashi Kiran Tikka. The production details indicate that the film is presented by Sony
